summary: The registrant, PIMCO Corporate & Income Opportunity Fund, filed an 8-K disclosing a board-approved change to its 80% investment policy, effective August 28, 2026. The policy now requires at least 80% of net assets be invested in corporate debt obligations of varying maturities and/or income-producing investments, including non-corporate issuers. This is a routine portfolio guideline adjustment, not a special situation event. No shareholder vote, advisor engagement, or financial terms were disclosed. The filing includes a supplement to the prospectus and statement of additional information. Investors should monitor for quarterly portfolio composition updates.
